title: MN-UPR MS RIV NATL WILDL-WELL REPAIRS
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE.US FISH AND WILDLIFE SERVICE.FWS, CONSTRUCTION A/E TEAM 2
description_text: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service is requesting a quote to seal two (2) artesian well per MN Rules 4725.3850 and Minnesota Statute 103I.301. Unused wells are required to be sealed and notice of the sealing registered with the state. A copy of the well sealing log will be provided to the Field Station and the Regional Environmental Compliance Coordinator. This work shall be conducted by a licensed contractor or a licensed well-sealing contractor per Minnesota Statues, Section 103I.301. Site Visit: 5/14/2026, @ 9:00 AM CST, Point of Contact: Robert McGinn, Robert_mcginn@fws.gov Location: Winona District Shop, 3 Kansas Street, Winona, MN 55987 Questions Due: 5/15/2026, to Bill Koski, William_koski@ios.doi.gov Quotes Due: 5/28/2026, to Bill Koski, William_koski@ios.doi.gov
